school: 全真道创始人（武举出身、活死人墓自证、山东度七真、立五会三教合一的北宗祖师）
historical_significance: 王重阳（1113-1170），京兆咸阳人，全真道创始人。早年业儒，中金天眷年间武举甲科，任终南县酒监；怀才不遇，正隆四年（1159）甘河遇异人证道，大定元年（1161）弃家入道，于终南刘蒋村自筑'活死人墓'独居两年余，以自囚证道、以死喻生。1167年焚庵东行赴山东宁海，半年内度化马钰一家，两年间先后收马钰、谭处端、丘处机、刘处玄、王处一、郝大通、孙不二七大弟子（全真七子），并在宁海、福山、登州、莱州、掖县连建三教七宝、金莲、三光、玉华、平等五会——以'三教'冠会名、以三教经典共诵，把初创教团一次布局成跨州网络。立教宗旨'全真'：识心见性、先性后命、屏去妄幻、独全其真；以《道德经》《般若心经》《孝经》课徒，融儒之孝行、佛之空观、道之清静于一炉。1169年携马谭刘丘四弟子西归，1170年卒于开封，年五十八，葬终南刘蒋村（后为重阳祖庭）。生前指定马钰嗣教，留下《重阳立教十五论》等教义文本与七真分派的组织蓝图；身后数十年，七真各开一派，全真道成为金元北方第一大道门。他以'活死人墓'式的极端自证、以'三教合一'的兼容框架、以'就地织网'的传教工程，示范了一个创始人如何在世仅传道三年（1167-1170）而奠定延续八百年的教团。
historical_significance_en: Wang Chongyang (1113-1170), a native of Xianyang in Jingzhao, founder of the Quanzhen school of Daoism. Educated in the classics, he passed the military examination first class under Jin's Emperor Xizong and served as wine supervisor at Zhongnan; unfulfilled, in 1159 he met a mysterious master at the Gan River, and in 1161 left his family, building himself a 'Tomb of the Living Dead Man' at Liujiang in the Zhongnan hills and dwelling inside it over two years — self-imprisonment as proof, death as a gloss on life. In 1167 he burned his hut and went east to Ninghai in Shandong, converting Ma Yu's whole household within months; in two years he gathered the seven great disciples — Ma Yu, Tan Chuduan, Qiu Chuji, Liu Chuxuan, Wang Chuyi, Hao Datong, Sun Bu'er (the Seven Perfected of Quanzhen) — and founded in quick succession the 'Three Teachings' congregations of Seven Treasures, Golden Lotus, Three Lights, Jade Flower and Equality at Ninghai, Fushan, Dengzhou, Laizhou and Yexian, laying out a fledgling school at once as a trans-prefecture network. The doctrine 'Quanzhen' — perfecting the true: know the mind and see the nature, nature before life-force, casting off delusion to keep the true whole; the Daodejing, Heart Sutra and Classic of Filial Piety taught together, fusing Confucian filial conduct, Buddhist emptiness and Daoist clarity. In 1169 he returned west with four disciples and died in Kaifeng in 1170, aged fifty-eight, buried at Liujiang (later the Chongyang Patriarchal Court). He named Ma Yu heir, left the Fifteen Discourses and the doctrinal texts, and the blueprint of the Seven lineages; within decades each of the Seven Perfected founded a school, and Quanzhen became the greatest Daoist school of Jin-Yuan northern China. With the extreme self-proof of the living-dead tomb, the accommodating frame of the Three Teachings as one, and the evangelism of weaving networks where he stood, he showed how a founder could, in three years of teaching (1167-1170), lay the ground of an order lasting eight hundred years.
unique_thinking: 王重阳思维模式的独特性在于'以死证生、以网代点、以合代争'的三重设计：(1)自囚证道思维——把'活死人墓'做成公开的装置艺术：向旧我宣告死亡、向世人宣告新生，用可见的极端行为替不可见的道行背书，创始人的第一份信用由自我剥夺预付；(2)织网思维——不在一地深耕等待，而以两年半连建五会、度化七人，把传教做成跨州网络工程，个人未竟的事业由分布式节点接续；(3)兼容框架思维——不与儒佛争地盘而以'三教合一'收编它们的经典与信众，用《道德经》《心经》《孝经》共诵把三个市场的存量用户变成自己的用户，命名'全真'一词立起差异品牌；(4)先性后命的次第思维——修行先解决'心'的问题再谈'命'的功夫，把教义表达为清晰的优先级；(5)传承前置思维——四十八岁早逝的倒计时意识，使他在世时即指定嗣教者、写下立教文本、预设七真分派格局，把'身后八百年'压缩进'在世三年'的规划。他证明：一个创始人最贵的资产不是寿命，而是自证的信用、织成的网络与预写的蓝图。
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Wang Chongyang's thinking lies in a triple design — proving life by death, network over point, fusion over contest: (1) self-imprisonment as proof — the 'Tomb of the Living Dead Man' as public installation: death announced to the old self, birth to the world; visible extremity underwrites invisible attainment, the founder's first credit prepaid by self-stripping; (2) network weaving — not deep cultivation in one place but five congregations in two and a half years and seven converts, evangelism as a trans-prefecture engineering project, the unfinished work carried by distributed nodes; (3) the accommodating frame — not contesting Confucianism and Buddhism for ground but folding their classics and faithful into 'the Three Teachings as one', reciting Daodejing, Heart Sutra and Filial Piety together to turn three markets' existing users into his own, while the coined name 'Quanzhen' raises a distinct brand; (4) the order of priority — nature before life-force: settle the mind first, then the practices of the body, doctrine stated as clear precedence; (5) succession in advance — the countdown awareness of a man dead at fifty-eight made him name his heir, write the founding texts and design the Seven lineages while alive, compressing 'eight hundred years after' into a plan made in 'three years alive'. He proved a founder's dearest asset is not lifespan but self-proven credit, a woven network, and a blueprint written ahead.
civilization_zh: 金初的关陇与胶东道门：王重阳（1113-1170），原名中孚，字允卿，后改名德威，字世雄，入道后名喆，字知明，号重阳子，京兆咸阳人。幼业儒，曾中金熙宗天眷年间武举（甲科），任终南县酒监，因怀才不遇、愤然辞官。正隆四年（1159）于甘河镇遇异人授以真诀（'甘河证道'），金大定元年（1161）弃家入道，于终南刘蒋村筑墓自居其中，榜曰'活死人墓'，独居两年余，以死喻生、以墓证道。大定七年（1167）焚庵东行，赴山东宁海州传道，先后度化马钰（丹阳）、谭处端（长真）、丘处机（长春）、刘处玄（长生）、王处一（玉阳）、郝大通（广宁）、孙不二（清静散人）七人，史称'全真七子'；于宁海、福山、登州、莱州、掖县建三教七宝会、三教金莲会、三教三光会、三教玉华会、三教平等会五会，主张儒释道三教合一、以《道德经》《般若心经》《孝经》为门人日诵之经，倡'全真'之名——保全真性、不假外物。大定九年（1169）携马、谭、刘、丘四弟子西归关中，次年正月初四卒于开封，年五十八；葬终南刘蒋村故庵（后成重阳宫，元代为天下祖庭）。生前以马钰嗣教；其《重阳全真集》《重阳教化集》《重阳立教十五论》与弟子所记《重阳真人金关玉锁诀》，奠定全真道先性后命、识心见性、真行功行的教义骨架，身后十余年间七真各开一派，全真道蔚为北方大宗。
civilization_en: The Daoist world of early-Jin Guanzhong and Jiaodong: Wang Chongyang (1113-1170), originally named Zhongfu, courtesy name Yunqing, later Dwei/Shixiong, and after entering the way named Zhe, Zhiming, style Chongyangzi, a native of Xianyang in Jingzhao. Educated in the classics, he passed the military examination (first class) under Emperor Xizong of Jin and served as supervisor of the wine monopoly at Zhongnan, resigning in bitter disappointment. In the fourth year of Zhenglong (1159) he met a mysterious master at the Gan River who imparted the true secret; in 1161 he abandoned his family and at Liujiang village in Zhongnan built a tomb and dwelt inside it, placarded 'Tomb of the Living Dead Man', over two years alone, using death to gloss life and the grave to seal the way. In 1167 he burned his hut and went east to Shandong's Ninghai to preach, successively converting Ma Yu (Danyang), Tan Chuduan (Changzhen), Qiu Chuji (Changchun), Liu Chuxuan (Changsheng), Wang Chuyi (Yuyang), Hao Datong (Guangning) and Sun Bu'er (the Pure and Still One) — history's Seven Perfected of Quanzhen; at Ninghai, Fushan, Dengzhou, Laizhou and Yexian he founded five congregations (Seven Treasures, Golden Lotus, Three Lights, Jade Flower, Equality), all styled 'Three Teachings', holding Confucian, Buddhist and Daoist ways to be one, with the Daodejing, the Heart Sutra and the Classic of Filial Piety as daily reading, and the name 'Quanzhen' — perfecting the true nature, borrowing nothing from outside. In 1169 he returned west with four disciples (Ma, Tan, Liu, Qiu) and died in Kaifeng on the fourth of the first month, 1170, aged fifty-eight; he was buried at his old hut in Liujiang (later the Chongyang Palace, the Patriarch's Court of the Yuan). He named Ma Yu heir to the leadership; his Collected Works, Works of Conversion, Fifteen Discourses on Founding the Teaching and the Golden Lock Secrets set the doctrinal skeleton of Quanzhen — nature before life-force, knowing the mind and seeing the nature, true deed and true practice — and within a decade of his death each of the Seven founded a lineage, Quanzhen rising as the great school of the north.
roles_en: Advocate of the Three Teachings as One
key_works: 《重阳真人金关玉锁诀》（弟子记）

cross_references.description_zh: 王重阳与丘处机是师与徒的两代传教工程：王重阳以'活死人墓'与山东五会完成从零到一的布网，丘处机以万里西行与一言止杀完成从一到天下的放大。重阳设计了'分而不裂'的七真格局，丘处机正是其中被这套设计放大到极致的节点——师创制度，徒用制度。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Chongyang and Qiu Chuji are two generations of one evangelizing project: the founder, with the living-dead tomb and the five Shandong congregations, wove the network from zero to one; the disciple, with the ten-thousand-li journey and one word that stayed the slaughter, scaled it from one to all under heaven. Chongyang designed the seven-lineage order that branches without breaking; Qiu was the very node that design amplified to the utmost — the teacher made the institution, the disciple worked it.

cross_references.description_zh: 王重阳与莲花生同以'收编而非消灭'植入新教团：莲花生入吐蕃把苯教神祇收编为护法，王重阳在山东把儒佛经典与信众收编进'三教合一'的框架。两人都懂得：新事物的生路不在旧事物的废墟上，而在把旧事物改造成自己的接口。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Chongyang and Padmasambhava both planted a new school by absorbing rather than destroying: Padmasambhava entering Tibet subsumed Bon deities as dharma-protectors; Wang in Shandong folded Confucian and Buddhist classics and faithful into the frame of the Three Teachings as one. Both knew the new thing lives not on the ruins of the old but by rebuilding the old as its own interface.

cross_references.description_zh: 王重阳与孔子同为'带七十二/七位弟子而教'的创始人：孔子以因材施教分出德行、言语、政事、文学四科，王重阳刻意培养七位性情各异的弟子使身后分派即扩容。两人都把弟子群体本身设计成事业的分布式版本。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Chongyang and Confucius both founded by teaching a small band — seven and seventy: Confucius split his teaching among four studies by each pupil's cast; Wang deliberately shaped seven disciples of differing temperament so that posthumous branching was expansion by design. Both made the disciple body itself the distributed version of the work.

cross_references.description_zh: 王重阳与张载同为宋金之际重构精神传统的关中人：张载以气本论重建儒门宇宙论、身后由门人整理《正蒙》而传关学，王重阳生前即主动立教、立会、立嗣、立文本。一个把立言留给身后，一个把自己的名字压在事业的每一块砖上——同代关陇人对'传承'的两种答案。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Chongyang and Zhang Zai, men of the same Guanzhong generation, both rebuilt a spiritual tradition at the Jin-Song transition: Zhang Zai reconstructed the Confucian cosmos on qi, his Correcting Ignorance compiled by disciples after death to found the Guanxue school; Wang in his lifetime actively founded the school, the congregations, the succession, the texts. One left the writing to posterity; the other pressed his own name into every brick of the work — two answers to legacy from the same Guanzhong generation.
